notes.title: Release of the Coloring Game: Little City
notes.notes:
The long-awaited free Coloring Game: Little City has finally been released! You’re now able to enjoy 15 free images.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132190/Coloring_Game_Little_City/

The first DLC for the game is going to become available in a week.
[b]Base price: $1.99.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141811/Coloring_Game_Little_City__No1/

Another four DLCs will be released till the end of the year at the same price ($1.99). 

If you’ve decided to purchase the whole additional content for the Coloring Game: Little City, then you’ll be able to do that with a considerable discount thanks to the Season Pass.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141810/Coloring_Game_Little_City__Season_Pass/

Please keep in mind that there will be no discounts for the DLCs for the Coloring Game: Little City in 2019. 

[h1]Don’t forget to leave reviews on the new game! )[/h1]
